title: KM VMS 0.8.1 — Universal Update Continuity and Compact Confirmation
summary: Preserves valid historical migration evidence across later releases, safely recovers the known pre-mutation legacy gate false failure, and uses the shared compact application confirmation for updates.
changelog: Validates each historical migration plan against its own stored registry fingerprint instead of incorrectly requiring today's fingerprint.
Recovers only the signed legacy_migration_history_unknown_id false failure when the database is already exact and no mutation attempt started.
Keeps arbitrary, mutated or ambiguous failed migration controls blocked and preserves historical database evidence without rewriting it.
Uses the shared Storage-style compact application dialog for update confirmation without duplicated update details or a test-only button.
Keeps atomic release-slot activation and automatic post-activation rollback in the separate planned Stage 6.6.1.
